script: In Japan, love is starting to disappear in a way that feels almost unreal. Not because people don’t want connection. But because life has become too expensive, too stressful, and too exhausting. Many young people work long hours, live in small apartments, and barely have energy after the day ends. Dating costs money. Marriage costs money. Children cost even more. So instead of chasing romance, many just choose peace. They stay single. They focus on hobbies, games, idols, work, or online worlds where nobody expects too much from them. And slowly, relationships start to feel less like a dream… and more like another responsibility. The sad part is, many of them aren’t cold. They’re not emotionless. They’re just tired. Tired of pressure. Tired of expectations. Tired of trying to build a future that feels impossible to afford. So Japan becomes this strange place where love is everywhere in anime, dramas, songs, and advertisements… but in real life, more and more people are choosing to be alone.
title: The Great Emu War
hook_text: In Japan, love is starting to disappear in a way that feels almost unreal.
